findings: In `components[1].sound`, the Zhengzhang rows compare readings for 斤 and 听, but the entry explicitly says those readings are not matched to the older smiling-word sense. They therefore do not substantiate the phonetic role and should not be presented as component–host sound comparisons. Remove those rows; retain the Modern Mandarin pair (斤 jīn, 听 tīng) as a current comparison, and keep the cited limitation that it does not establish the historical relation. The received phonetic analysis can remain qualified as a transmitted analysis.
